name: Yale SOM · Evans Hall
description: Yale School of Management's Evans Hall on three floors: round classrooms where AI avatars of real professors teach (click one to chat), Labubu students, glass meeting rooms, spiral stairs, a café and a courtyard. Every professor here is an AI avatar, not the real person.
